name: Pole-mounted luminaire plan mark
summary: Site-plan mark for a luminaire on a pole or column, drawn as a pole base with the luminaire arm.
description: Pole-mounted luminaires for car parks, roads and sites are drawn on site plans as a small circle or square for the pole base with the luminaire on an arm. The pole height and fitting type are tagged, and the cable route between poles is shown.
Poles need a foundation, an earthing arrangement and a base compartment with a cut-out or fuse. The plan symbol therefore links electrical, civil and lighting design.
The symbol does not give the pole height, arm length or foundation detail. Those come from the schedule and civil drawings.
readingNotes: Follow the cable route between poles.
drawingChecklist: State pole height and arm configuration.
distinction: A wall-mounted luminaire fixes to a building; this form stands on its own pole.
